 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr. Surendra Kumar Singh, Advocate
 Mr. Prabhat Kumar Singh, Advocate
 Ms. Priya, Advocate
For the Respondent/s : Mr. Satya Narayan Prasad, Advocate

=
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Vipul M. Pancholi
 and
 Honourable Mr. Justice Rudra Prakash Mishra
 Oral Order

(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE VIPUL M. PANCHOLI)
3 15-01-2024 Heard Mr. Surendra Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Satya Narayan Prasad,
learned A.P.P. for the respondent-State.
2.

In the present case, the appellant has preferred this appeal under Section 374(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, wherein the appellant has challenged the order of Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No. 797 of 2023(3) dt.15-01-2024 conviction dated 01.07.2023 and order of sentence dated 10.07.2023 passed in POCSO Case No. 25 of 2023, arising out of Koilwar P.S. Case No. 238 of 2016, whereby VI-th

and Sessions Judge cum Exclusive POCSO Court, Bhojpur,
Ara, has convicted the appellant under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of twenty years and a fine of Rs. 50,000/- and in default of payment of fine to further undergo rigorous imprisonment for six months.

3. As the trial Court has recorded conviction under Section 376(D) of the I.P.C., as per the provisions contained under Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the appeal filed by the appellant is required to be heard within a period of six months.

sentences.text:
4. Office is directed to prepare the paper-book immediately and, thereafter, list this matter for hearing under the heading "for hearing" on 26.02.2024.
5.
If the appeal is not heard on or before 15.04.2024, liberty is reserved to the appellant to file separate I.A. under Section 389(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
6. As this Court has fixed the appeal for hearing, learned counsel for the appellant does not press the prayer for Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No. 797 of 2023(3) dt.15-01-2024 grant of the bail.
7. It is further clarified that this Court has not examined the merits of the case of the appellant.

(Vipul M. Pancholi, J) ( Rudra Prakash Mishra, J) Alok Verma/-
